blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25712463 (2026-08-08T19:53:59Z; hash 0x618ff702108d99dab9aefdef506ad07bb2bf95a86f571ea65db27698420510af), the sole tracked USDaf deployment 0x9cf12ccd6020b6888e4d4c4e4c7aca33c1eb91f8 returned owner() = zero and zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots; its runtime code remained the verified direct BoldToken deployment. The pinned and verified source exposes ordinary holder transfer and allowance transferFrom behavior, a fixed core-contract recipient guard, and fixed protocol mint/burn routes, but no mutable pause, holder blacklist, seizure, or arbitrary-holder burn. The reviewed project materials and holder terms identify protocol and reserve risks but no separate issuer power to freeze existing USDaf balances. Direct holder freeze is therefore false; reserve-asset controls remain upstream dependencies rather than token access controls.

oracleRisk.summary: Six debt-bearing Ethereum Trove branches use immutable branch-local price feeds. ysyBOLD uses nested ERC-4626 conversion rates; scrvUSD, tBTC, and WBTC18 have active Curve-based fallback paths; sUSDS and sfrxUSD rely on single Chainlink paths. Invalid required prices irreversibly shut only the affected branch onto its last good price.

branchApplicability.rationale: The pinned official API registry enumerates six current branches. At finalized Ethereum block 25531806 every branch had a callable PriceFeed and TroveManager, shutdownTime zero, and debt; the scrvUSD and WBTC18 branches retained dust debt and therefore remain liquidation-active rather than exclusions. The WBTC registry row's current ActivePool resolves to the verified WBTC18 wrapper over canonical WBTC.

branches.label: ysyBOLD Trove branch
branches.summary: The branch prices st-yBOLD from its ERC-4626 conversion into yBOLD and yBOLD's ERC-4626 conversion into USDaf/BOLD; the implementation explicitly assumes BOLD remains solvent and has no external market feed or fallback.

feeds.path: st-yBOLD 0x23346B04a7f55b8760E5860AA5A77383D63491cD convertToAssets -> yBOLD 0x9F4330700a36B29952869fac9b33f45EEdd8A3d8 convertToAssets -> USDaf/BOLD par assumption

branches.fallbackBehavior: There is no alternate provider. The outer WETHPriceFeed uses a uint256.max staleness threshold for the block-timestamped nested conversion response; an invalid or reverting nested aggregator call is caught and, when adequate gas remains, irreversibly shuts the branch and returns lastGoodPrice rather than selecting another source.

collateralParameters.note: AddressesRegistry 0x3414bd84dff0900a9046a987f4df2e0ef08fa1ce; TroveManager 0xF8a25a2E4c863bb7CEa7e4B4eeb3866BB7f11718; ActivePool 0xB87E1e1c4CC2DEcaDa13025a8DC8A94bdB77fB63; CCR 120%, BCR 10%, SP penalty 5%, redistribution penalty 10%; debt was 225403.478025211254609384 USDaf and shutdownTime was zero.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Anyone may call batchLiquidateTroves with Trove IDs; an ICR below the 110% MCR is immediately liquidatable. Debt is offset against the branch Stability Pool first and any remainder is redistributed with seized collateral to active Troves.
branches.backstop: Branch Stability Pool 0x83e5BDe77d7477eCd972E338541b90Af57675536 absorbs debt first and permits just-in-time deposits; uncovered debt and collateral are redistributed to remaining active Troves. No external insurance or committed auction capital exists.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Anyone can irreversibly shut the branch when TCR falls below 105%; required-oracle failure also invokes shutdown and freezes lastGoodPrice. Borrowing and interest stop while closing, liquidations, Stability Pool operations, and 2%-bonus urgent redemptions remain. The implementation has no final bad-debt cure, so debt can remain if collateral is exhausted.

branches.label: scrvUSD Trove branch
branches.summary: scrvUSD is priced from Chainlink crvUSD/USD times the ERC-4626 share rate, with an enabled Curve AggregateStablePrice fallback before the branch's last-good-price shutdown path.

feeds.path: enabled fallback 0x2b36d82bFB9EA09BBEd084bE34Df942AAd0EEb35 -> Curve aggregate 0x18672b1b0c623a30089A280Ed9256379fb0E4E62 -> scrvUSD share rate

branches.fallbackBehavior: If the primary answer is non-positive or at least 172800 seconds old, the custom oracle selects its enabled Curve fallback, whose timestamp is block.timestamp. If the required share-rate or selected custom oracle path reverts or the outer 172800-second validation fails, the branch irreversibly shuts down and thereafter serves lastGoodPrice.

branches.label: tBTC Trove branch
branches.summary: tBTC uses Chainlink tBTC/USD with an enabled Curve tBTC/USD fallback, then takes the lower of that market route and Chainlink BTC/USD for normal pricing.

feeds.path: Chainlink tBTC/USD 0x8350b7De6a6a2C1368E7D4Bd968190e13E354297; if invalid, enabled fallback 0x193B7da0F8036709774054dfd7539cA36654AbA5 -> Curve tBTC/USD aggregate 0xbeF434E2aCF0FBaD1f0579d2376fED0d1CfC4217
Chainlink BTC/USD 0xF4030086522a5bEEa4988F8cA5B36dbC97BeE88c; normal price is min(tBTC market route, BTC/USD), while this canonical feed is ignored rather than substituted if invalid

branches.fallbackBehavior: A non-positive or at least 172800-second-old tBTC Chainlink answer selects the enabled Curve fallback. The outer PriceFeed rejects a required market answer older than 172800 seconds; BTC/USD canonical failure is ignored, not failover. Unrecoverable market-route failure irreversibly shuts the branch to lastGoodPrice.
